encode_chunked.note: b58encode_int peels five digits per big-integer divmod (base**5 fits one internal int digit, so each division costs the same as a division by base) and builds the output in a bytearray instead of prepending to bytes.

decode_chunked.note: b58decode_int accumulates five digits in a small int and folds them into the big integer with one multiply-add, so the number of big-integer operations drops five-fold.
